senses.gloss: सिकता- + रेणु सिकता- + रेणु, m. a grain of sand, Pañc. ii. d. 62.

शिक्य, शिक्य, n., and f. या,
 1. The string suspended from either end of a pole to receive a burthen.
 2. The burthen so carried.
 3. The strings of a balance.

शिक्षा शिक्षा, i. e. शिक्ष, desider. of शक्, + अ, f.
 1. Learning, Johns. Sel. 8, 3; Rājat. 5, 318; study.
 2. One of [] the six Vedāṅgas, treating of pronunciation, Madhusūdana in Weber, Ind. St. i. 16.
 3. Modesty.
 --Comp.
1. शीक् शीक् or सीक् सीक् (probably better, cf. सिच्), i. 1, Ātm. To sprinkle, Bhaṭṭ. 14, 76.

† 2. शीक् शीक्, सीक् सीक्, i. 1, Ātm. To go, to move.
 --i. 1, and 10, Par.
 1. To be angry.
 2. To endure patiently.
 3. To touch.
† 3. शीक् शीक्, i. 10, Par. To speak, to shine.

शीकर शीकर (cf. 1. शीक्),
 I. m.
 1. A drop of water, Ragh. 16, 62; of rain, Śāk. d. 166.
 2. Thin rain, Ṛt. 1, 15; Kir. 5, 15 (also सीकर, MBh. 14, 2201).
 3. Spray, Mālat. 147, 14.
 II. n. A sort of pine, or its resin.
 --Comp.
शीकरिन् शीकरिन्, i. e. शीकर + इन्, adj. Sprinkling, Utt. Rāmac. 63, 5.

सिकत सिकत,
 I. m. pl. Sand.
 II. f. ता.
 1. Sandy soil.
 2. Sand, Vikr. d. 79 (pl.); Pañc. ii. d. 62.
 3. Gravel or stone (the disease).
सिकतामय सिकता + मय, adj., f. यी, सिकतावन्त् सिकता + वन्त्, adj., f. वती, and सिकतिल सिकतिल, i. e. सिकता + इल, adj. Sandy, Bhartṛ. 3, 49 (तिल, see Böhtl. Ind. Spr. 2721).

सिक्थ सिक्थ, i. e. सिच् + थ.
 I. m.
 1. Boiled rice.
 2. A lump or ball of [] boiled rice, Skanda P., Kāśīkh. 81, 38.
 II. n.
 1. Beeswax.
 2. Indigo.
